result:
task: Add acceptance cases to `tests/acceptance/W2-58/` for the five behaviours the independent review found missing (DAEO-5j8b), and show them red against the current code.
status: DONE — 178 cases added (117 red, 61 green) and committed as `e49fd98d`; every existing case still passes.
work_completed: Step 0 sandbox check passed. (a) The write failed with `OSError: [Errno 30] Read-only file system`. (b) `git hash-object -w` printed `1ae28402…` and exited 0, and `git update-index --refresh` exited 0. `GOV_ROLE=independent-test-designer`, `GOV_TICKET=DAEO-5j8b`, top level `/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-58`, branch `w2/W2-58`. I wrote `test_w2_58_review.py` (178 cases) and added a "Review cases (fifth round; DEC-136)" section to the README, which maps each behaviour to its tests and its red reason. Added per item: 1 = 75 (26 red); 2 = 15 (12 red); 3 = 8 (7 red); 4 = 32 (30 red); 5 = 48 (42 red). I did not change any existing case or the support module. The subagent and environment-recording helpers are local to the new file.
files_changed: tests/acceptance/W2-58/test_w2_58_review.py (new); tests/acceptance/W2-58/README.md
evidence: commit `e49fd98d` with trailers `Task: DAEO-5j8b`, `Role: independent-test-designer`, `Implements: DEC-820`, `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`. `git log --oneline -3` shows e49fd98d, 8caf47db, 7bd32fd7. `git status --short` shows no tracked changes; it shows untracked root entries that are not mine (`.bashrc`, `.gitconfig`, `.mcp.json`, `docs/source`, …), and I left them alone. Code under test: `PYTHONPATH=/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-58/src python3 -c "import gov; print(gov.__file__)"` printed `/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-58/src/gov/__init__.py`. Every red case fails with `decision=allow exit=0`, which is the intended reason. Item 5's expectation comes from the base source (`git show w2/integrate:src/gov/guard/protected.py`, `_command_reads`): a Bash word that names either file was refused to every role as a read, unless it was a write target of its own command, in which case the allow-list refused it for these roles.
tests: Full run `… pytest tests/acceptance/W2-58 -q -p no:cacheprovider -rs -m "not local_only"`: 117 failed, 632 passed, 5 deselected (live cases) in 258 s. All 117 failures are in `test_w2_58_review.py`. Before: 576 cases (571 run plus 5 live), all passing. After: 754 cases. Failing groups: `test_the_engineer_is_refused_file_names_given_at_run_time_that_take_in_ts_tests` [7], `test_the_test_designer_is_refused_file_names_given_at_run_time_that_take_in_the_changed_files` [7], `test_a_measured_session_is_refused_file_names_given_at_run_time_that_take_in_the_hidden_part` [12], `test_a_subagent_of_an_engineer_session_is_refused_ts_tests` [10], `test_a_subagent_of_a_test_designer_session_is_refused_the_changed_files` [2], `test_an_engineer_whose_ticket_is_given_by_its_wbs_id_is_refused_ts_tests` [3], `test_a_session_measured_by_a_ticket_given_by_its_wbs_id_is_refused_the_hidden_part` [2], `test_gov_launch_accepts_a_ticket_named_by_its_wbs_id_and_its_session_is_refused_ts_tests`, `test_gov_launch_by_wbs_id_of_a_measured_ticket_hands_on_a_ticket_the_guard_measures`, `test_a_credential_file_is_refused` [24], `test_every_role_is_refused_each_credential_file_by_the_read_tool` [6], `test_a_write_to_the_held_out_list_or_the_settings_file_stays_refused` [42]. Every allowed counterpart passes, including the engineer's `pytest … | tail` runs and the 28 cases for sessions with no protected part.
discoveries: `gov launch engineer W2-95` already starts a session and hands on `GOV_TICKET=W2-95`. The gap in item 3 is in the guard alone: it does not resolve a WBS id to its ticket, so it refuses nothing under (c) or (d). For item 5, every write form tested (`dd of=`, `truncate`, `sort -o`, `rsync`, `patch`, `git checkout --`, `git restore`) is now allowed on both files for the engineer, test designer and research roles. On the base, only the read rule stopped them, so opening reads widened writes the write extractor does not recognise.
risks: Two readings are mine and stated in the README. "Untyped" is tested as `agent_type: general-purpose`; a call with no `agent_type` at all is not asserted. Item 1's forms are judged at the guard only; nothing is run.
lessons: `gov retrieve` returned no evidence (`FACET_UNAVAILABLE`, both indexes "stale"). I used it once, for the guard's pipe and subagent read rules, and read the suite and the base source instead. Guard read refusals met: 0. I read no file of the ticket's implementation, only tests under `tests/acceptance/` and base versions through `git show w2/integrate:`.
proposed_decisions: none. No existing case asserts the opposite of any of the five behaviours. W1-02's `test_a_subagent_can_still_read` reads source code, not T's tests, and W1-02's pipe cases leave `xargs` out explicitly.
unresolved: The 5 `local_only` live cases were not run here (the sandbox blocks network access); the lead runs them as before. Whether a search from a folder above a `.env`- or `.secrets`-named file should be refused is still the owner's to decide, and is not asserted either way.
recommended_next_action: Send the engineer an iteration to turn the 117 review cases green without breaking the 632 that pass.
